title: The Transfiguration and Faith to Move Mountains

questions.question: Six days later, which three disciples did Jesus take with Him up a high mountain by themselves?
options: Peter, James, and John his brother
questions.correctAnswer: Peter, James, and John his brother
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:1 (ESV): "And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James, and John his brother, and led them up a high mountain by themselves."

questions.question: As Jesus was transfigured before them, what did His face and clothes look like?
options: His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became white as light
He was enveloped in a pillar of fire
He put on garments of pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became white as light
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:2 (ESV): "And he was transfigured before them, and his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became white as light."

questions.question: Which two figures appeared and were talking with Jesus during His transfiguration?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:3 (ESV): "And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah, talking with him."

questions.question: What did Peter offer to make for Jesus, Moses, and Elijah on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:4 (ESV): "And Peter said to Jesus, 'Lord, it is good that we are here. If you wish, I will make three tents here, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah.'"

questions.question: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said what?
options: "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him."
"These are my prophets of old; hear their words."
"Behold the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him."
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:5 (ESV): "He was still speaking when, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, 'This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him.'"

questions.question: How did the disciples react when they heard the voice from the cloud?
options: They fell on their faces and were terrified
They began to prophesy entirely new things
questions.correctAnswer: They fell on their faces and were terrified
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:6 (ESV): "When the disciples heard this, they fell on their faces and were terrified."

questions.question: As they were coming down the mountain, what did Jesus command them?
options: "Tell no one the vision, until the Son of Man is raised from the dead."
"Write down all that you saw here today."
"Go and tell all the disciples in the valley."
"Wait here until Moses and Elijah return."
questions.correctAnswer: "Tell no one the vision, until the Son of Man is raised from the dead."
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:9 (ESV): "And as they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, 'Tell no one the vision, until the Son of Man is raised from the dead.'"

questions.question: When the disciples asked about Elijah coming first, Jesus said that Elijah has already come, but they did not recognize him. Who did the disciples understand He was talking about?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:12-13 (ESV): "...they did to him whatever they pleased. So also the Son of Man will certainly suffer at their hands. Then the disciples understood that he was speaking to them of John the Baptist."

questions.question: A man knelt before Jesus, begging for mercy for his son, because he often falls into the fire or water due to a what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:15 (ESV): "'Lord, have mercy on my son, for he has seizures and he suffers terribly. For often he falls into the fire, and often into the water.'"

questions.question: Why did the disciples fail to heal the boy, according to Jesus?
options: Because the demon was too old
Because they had not fasted for seven days
Because they did not speak loudly enough
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:20 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Because of your little faith. For truly, I say to you, if you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain...'"

questions.question: Jesus said that with faith like a grain of mustard seed, what could they say to a mountain?
options: "Move from here to there," and it will move
"Split in half," and it will be sundered
"Sink into the sea," and the land will be flat
questions.correctAnswer: "Move from here to there," and it will move
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:20 (ESV): "For truly, I say to you, if you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move, and nothing will be impossible for you."

questions.question: In Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax (temple tax) approached Peter. They asked him what?
options: "Does your teacher not pay the tax?"
"Why does your master heal on the Sabbath?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Does your teacher not pay the tax?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:24 (ESV): "When they came to Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax went up to Peter and said, 'Does your teacher not pay the tax?'"

questions.question: Inside the house, Jesus asked Peter if the kings of the earth take toll or tax from their sons, or from others. What did Peter answer?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:25-26 (ESV): "'From whom do kings of the earth take toll or tax? From their sons or from others?' And when he said, 'From others,' Jesus said to him, 'Then the sons are free.'"

questions.question: Why did Jesus say they should still pay the tax?
options: Not to give offense to them
To show obedience to the Romans
To uphold the law of Moses forever
Because they had plenty of gold
questions.correctAnswer: Not to give offense to them
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:27 (ESV): "However, not to give offense to them, go to the sea and cast a hook and take the first fish that comes up..."

questions.question: Where did Jesus tell Peter he would find the shekel to pay the tax for both of them?
options: In the mouth of the first fish he caught with a hook
Under a stone by the lakeshore
In the bag of a passing traveler
questions.correctAnswer: In the mouth of the first fish he caught with a hook
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:27 (ESV): "...take the first fish that comes up, and when you open its mouth you will find a shekel. Take that and give it to them for me and for yourself."

key_verse_text: He was still speaking when, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to him."
